state_machine_evidence.interpretation: The old client does contain a single item/shop/storage-style state machine with multiple GameInter panel variants. It does not yet prove which state is named warehouse versus NPC shop, so those business labels remain candidates.

paint_geometry.item_grid_note: These are raw SetRect constants from the binary. The right-side 4×3 grid is exact at constructor level; parent origin/meaning remains unresolved because it does not fit the currently bound 300-pixel visible background.

paint_order.evidence: The paint entry first derives the clipping RECT from state byte this+0x5F8: state 1, state 4, or the stored window rectangle for other states.

paint_order.role: visible item rows and item icon composition
paint_order.evidence: The linked item list is traversed, resource IDs are selected through 0x466130, source/destination rectangles are normalized and composited through 0x4542F0, and up to five visible rows are processed.

paint_order.role: selected-row/item marker and item description region
paint_order.evidence: The selected-row branch performs the float/compositor pipeline, invokes selection marker 0x45E570 and emits the item description area through the recovered text/auxiliary calls.

paint_order.role: price or quantity and row text
paint_order.evidence: The item record is decoded, runtime value this+0x24 is formatted with 0x47C784 (%d两), and row text is emitted through 0x45DD70.
The alternate item branch repeats the record/value text path and then calls the auxiliary item-action routine when its state flags are set.
